Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface UsageTrackingPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
UsageTrackingAdapter
public interface UsageTrackingPort
Outbound port for tracking per-subscriber monthly AI query usage.

Implementations live in infrastructure.persistence. The domain and application layers depend only on this interface — no JPA or storage technology details leak inward.

Each subscriber has at most one usage record per calendar month, identified by the yearMonth string (format "YYYY-MM").

  • Method Details

    • getOrCreateUsage

      UsageRecord getOrCreateUsage(String email, String yearMonth)
      Retrieves the usage record for the given subscriber and month, creating a new record with zero count if none exists.
      Parameters:
      email - Subscriber email address.
      yearMonth - Month in "YYYY-MM" format.
      Returns:
      The current (or newly created) usage record; never null.

    • incrementAndGet

      UsageRecord incrementAndGet(String email, String yearMonth)
      Atomically increments the query count for the given subscriber and month, then returns the updated record. If no record exists, one is created with a count of 1.
      Parameters:
      email - Subscriber email address.
      yearMonth - Month in "YYYY-MM" format.
      Returns:
      The updated usage record with incremented count.

    • findAllByYearMonth

      List<UsageRecord> findAllByYearMonth(String yearMonth)
      Returns all usage records for a given month. Useful for admin reporting.
      Parameters:
      yearMonth - Month in "YYYY-MM" format.
      Returns:
      All records for the month; may be empty, never null.
